notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]4/17/2017
notes.notes:
Patch V1.0.0.3 was released today.

PATCH NOTES

     999: Issue where save data cannot be loaded in certain locations is now fixed.
     999: Fixed issue where game would crash if PC was unable to play a movie file.
     999/VLR: Fixed issue where game would crash if game data failed to save. 
     999/VLR: Improved stability.

notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]3/31/2017
notes.notes:
Patch V1.0.0.2 was released today.

PATCH NOTES

     VLR: Fixed bug where game would sometimes freeze on black screen instead of closing. 

We thank you for your patience and understanding as we investigate the remaining issues.

notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]3/28/2017
notes.notes:
Patch V1.0.0.1 was released today.

PATCH NOTES

     Fixed bug where game would crash if an achievement unlocked during Offline Mode.
(This fixes the Endings crash.)
 

We thank you for your patience and understanding as we investigate the remaining issues.
